## Research Pillars
- Physical & Extractive Metallurgy: Phase transformations, microstructural evolution, sustainable mineral processing and beneficiation workflows.
- Computational Materials Science: Materials Informatics, Machine Learning (ML), and CALPHAD-based modeling for accelerated alloy discovery.
- Surfaces, Interfaces & Degradation: Nanotribology, multifunctional coatings, and environmental degradation mechanisms (corrosion, wear, oxidation).
- Sustainable Materials & Circular Economy: Direct recycling and regeneration of NMC cathode battery materials.

## Technical Skills
- Informatics & AI: Python (Scikit-learn, Pandas), PyTorch, PyCalphad, Pymatgen, MatGL, Bayesian Optimization, Agentic AI Workflows, RAG.
- Characterization: SEM/EDX, XRD (Rietveld refinement), XRF, Optical Metallography, Tensile & Hardness Testing, CSWIP 3.1.
- Simulation & Tools: MATLAB, OriginPro, ImageJ, Schrödinger Materials Suite, Thermo-Calc, COMSOL Multiphysics, LAMMPS, Quantum ESPRESSO.
